propositions: The close precheck scans all reachable commit messages and calls resolve_ticket_id for each extracted reference, causing unrelated historical ambiguous-prefix matches to print stderr diagnostics despite not affecting gate decisions.
The precheck returns correct gate results (True for valid full-ID trailer, False for unreferenced ID) but emits spurious ambiguity error messages for unrelated historical short-prefix candidates.
Resolving references from a history-wide scan should suppress ambiguity diagnostics, while user-supplied ambiguous prefixes in explicit commands must still display full diagnostics.
The fix adds a quiet keyword-only parameter to resolve_ticket_id to gate three stderr print statements, and passes quiet=True only from _referencing_commit_exists's scanning loop.
